About

I'm a sophomore at Carnegie Mellon University studying for a BS in Statistics and Data Science with a Minor in Computational Finance, on track to graduate in 2029 (with early graduation in 2028 possible). I'm focused on breaking into quantitative trading, sales & trading, market making, quant research, and hedge fund analyst roles.

Most of my time outside class goes into building and testing trading systems — from a live algorithmic operation on Kalshi's prediction markets to derivatives research on volatility signals around FOMC events. I like problems where you have to think in probabilities and sizes, not certainties.
